tagline: Over Big Mountain on the pioneers' line, when the snow allows.
intro: From Morgan, SR-66 heads south up East Canyon beside East Canyon Creek, through Porterville and Richville, to the reservoir at East Canyon State Park. There the byway turns onto SR-65 and climbs over Big Mountain Pass, then comes down past Little Dell Reservoir to I-80 in Parleys Canyon, winding through canyons, farmland and forest.

The road keeps old company. It follows parts of the Mormon, California and Pony Express trails, and when SR-65 was made a state highway in 1931 it was meant to follow the Mormon Trail as closely as practicable.

moments.title: Morgan
moments.text: Settled around 1861 and put on the map by the Union Pacific in 1868 and 1869, this is the town in and around which most of the 1989 horror film Troll 2 was shot.

moments.title: East Canyon State Park
moments.text: The road winds along the north end of a 680-acre reservoir in a narrow-walled canyon, held back by a concrete arch dam 259 feet high.

moments.title: Big Mountain Pass
moments.text: The Mormon pioneers crossed this 7,420-foot pass in 1847 on their way to the Salt Lake Valley, a year after the Donner Party came through.

practical: SR-65 south of Big Mountain closes each year from winter into spring.
